data.title: 五和 · 温泉旅馆水雾中的深情交缠
data.description: 柏木私人温泉中热水翻涌，天蓝色比基尼早已解开漂在水面。浑身泛着诱人粉色的五和紧紧跨坐在你的大腿上，湿透的短发贴在锁骨边，双手环绕在你的颈后，在急促娇喘中奉献出全部爱意。
data.location: steamy traditional Japanese cedarwood onsen tub
data.action: 在温泉中跨坐在对方大腿上，湿透短发贴在锁骨边，双手环颈娇喘依偎
data.lighting: steamy lantern light dancing across rippling hot water and wet skin
data.promptProse: In a private wooden ryokan hot spring swirling with warm steam and soft lantern glow, Itsuwa sits astride her partner's lap and wraps both arms tightly behind his neck. Damp locks stick to her flushed neck as she breathes against his cheek.
data.animaCaption: Straddling her partner's thighs inside the steaming cedar ryokan bath with both arms looped around his neck, she presses close with wet hair clinging to her flushed collarbone while her untied sky-blue bikini drifts loose in the water.
data.nsfwProse: Her ruffled sky-blue string bikini is untied and floating free on the bathwater, leaving her rosy wet chest and bare shoulders pressed directly against her partner.
